title: Component store: quick check
desc: DISM CheckHealth. Reads corruption flag; does not repair.

title: Component store: thorough scan
desc: DISM ScanHealth. Longer diagnostic, no repair.

title: Protected files: verification
desc: SFC VerifyOnly. Reports integrity violations without repairs.

title: Repair component store then files
desc: DISM RestoreHealth followed by SFC only if DISM succeeds. May download files.

title: Repair protected files (SFC)
desc: Runs sfc /scannow independently; can take time.

title: Pending restart indicators
desc: Checks update, servicing and file-operation restart markers.

title: Recent Windows system errors
desc: Recent Level 2 System event entries, not a repair.

title: Reliability Monitor
desc: Opens crash and update reliability history.

title: Restart Explorer and taskbar
desc: Closes Explorer windows and reloads taskbar/desktop; no reboot.

title: Explorer and taskbar settings
desc: Open taskbar configuration and Explorer options.

title: Task Manager and Resource Monitor
desc: Open diagnostic GUIs; no task is terminated.

title: Recent Explorer/Task Manager crashes
desc: Scans Application errors for explorer.exe and Taskmgr.exe.

title: Reset Microsoft Store cache
desc: Runs Microsoft's wsreset.exe. Not app uninstall; Store may open.

title: Installed app repair options
desc: Open Settings: Installed apps > ... > Advanced options > Repair.

title: Display and graphics diagnostics
desc: DirectX Diagnostic Tool and installed graphics driver details.

title: Display settings / scale
desc: Open display settings; no resolution changes automated.

title: Audio device and service check
desc: Lists audio devices, service states, and opens sound controls.

title: Restart Windows Audio service
desc: May interrupt playback or recordings. Does not reinstall audio drivers.

title: Defender protection summary
desc: Check antivirus, real-time protection and signature age.

title: Defender and recent detections
desc: Reads recent detections; requires permissions on some systems.

title: Start Defender quick scan
desc: Starts on-demand malware scan. May take minutes.

title: Update Defender security signatures
desc: Downloads supported antivirus signatures; internet required.

title: Firewall profiles
desc: Displays firewall status; never turns protection off.

title: Windows Security dashboard
desc: Open graphical Windows Security controls without changing them.

title: TPM, Secure Boot and encryption
desc: Inspect security chip, Secure Boot and BitLocker on C:.

title: Controlled folder access / PUA
desc: Reads selected Defender preferences; never alters security.

title: Wi-Fi hotspot link
desc: Displays negotiated Wi-Fi link rate, NOT mobile tower throughput.

title: DNS, proxy and IP snapshot
desc: Read configured DNS, IP adapters and Windows proxy.

title: Internet latency and DNS
desc: 20 ICMP echo packets plus a DNS query; no downloads.

title: HTTPS connection check
desc: Checks TCP 443 only; successful result does not prove ZIP integrity.

title: Flush DNS resolver cache
desc: Clears cached DNS answers. Not a download-speed booster.

title: Reset Winsock networking
desc: Advanced repair when sockets malfunction; restart later, connections may change.

title: Open network troubleshooting
desc: Open Windows diagnostics UI; does not reset all adapters.

title: Driver error codes
desc: Show only devices with actual Error status and their problem codes.

title: Installed driver inventory CSV
desc: Save version inventory, NOT latest-vendor comparison.

title: Windows optional driver offers
desc: Opens official Windows Update page; no drivers installed.

title: Drive health and firmware
desc: Basic Windows storage health and firmware; not a full SMART test.

title: Scan C: online for filesystem issues
desc: chkdsk /scan reads/scans C: online; does not schedule offline /f.

title: Verify ZIP completely
desc: Checks ZIP directory and decompresses all entries without extraction.

title: File SHA-256 checksum
desc: Compare with a publisher checksum when provided.

title: App upgrades (WinGet)
desc: Checks supported installed apps; not Windows OS or firmware.

title: Upgrade supported apps
desc: Runs winget upgrade --all. Can download installers and prompt.

title: Windows Update troubleshooting
desc: Windows Update settings and troubleshooting UI; no reset.

title: Windows Update log export
desc: Creates a readable Windows Update log file for analysis.

title: Battery report
desc: Creates HTML battery report in your Documents report folder.

title: RAM usage snapshot
desc: Top 15 processes plus system available memory.

title: Print spooler status
desc: Shows printer spooler state, no changes.

title: Restart print spooler
desc: May interrupt outstanding print jobs. Use if printing is stuck.

title: Create Windows restore point
desc: Only if System Protection enabled; may fail due to 24-hour limit.

title: Startup apps and power requests
desc: Open Startup and list current sleep blockers.

title: System summary report
desc: Generate OS, RAM, storage, device and security snapshot in Documents.
